f.title: Submit all ICSRs only through the DRAP Industry e-reporting system from 8 November 2024
f.statement: All registration holders are directed to submit all future ICSRs, either as E2B XML files or as manual data entry reports, only through the Industry e-reporting system to NPC-DRAP, with effect from 8 November 2024.
f.clause: Letter F. No.9-13/2019-DDGS) of 30 October 2024, para 3
f.applicability: All registration holders of therapeutic goods in Pakistan
f.systems: DRAP Industry e-reporting system; ICH E2B XML

f.title: Consult the Industry e-reporting manual for registration holders
f.statement: For further guidance on the Industry e-reporting system, registration holders should consult the Industry e-reporting manual for registration holders (available on the DRAP website).
f.applicability: All registration holders of therapeutic goods in Pakistan

rows.quote: For further guidelines., the Industry e-reporting manual for registration holders should be consulted.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. 'should be consulted' kept Recommended. Double-check: 'should be consulted' = Recommended confirmed; below 90 because the actor (registration holders) is inferred from the letter's addressees, not named in the quoted sentence.

f.title: Nominate two Industry e-reporting users (preferably QPPV/LSO and backup) within 30 calendar days
f.statement: Registration holders are advised to submit, on the attached form (Annex-A), the details of two persons, preferably the QPPV / Local Safety Officer (LSO) and his/her backup, to the DRAP PV office (by mailing address and email) within thirty calendar days, to obtain user names/accounts and then start submitting data through the Industry e-reporting system. Two accounts are provided per registration holder.
f.applicability: All registration holders of therapeutic goods in Pakistan
